text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- King Hussein pardons Laith Shubailat, leading opposition figure and vocal critic of 1994 peace treaty with Israel; king personally drives Shubailat from prison and takes him to his mother's home; union and political circles praise king's step.
- International workshop in Amman starts on Saturday to evaluate peace process from Arab point of view.
- Jordan, United States on Sunday sign "open skies" aviation accord.
- Investment in Wadi Musa area estimated at about 40 million dinars ($56 million).
- Patrol foils attempt to smuggle tobacco and guns along Jordan-Iraq-Saudi border area.
- Jordan Businessmen's Association says it will take part in Cairo economic conference.
- King, Crown Prince meet Turkish air force chief.
